events.text: The paper was founded as Päivälehti.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The paper was founded in 1889 as Päivälehti

events.text: Päivälehti was forced to close permanently.
events.subject: self

events.text: Its proprietors re-opened the paper under its current name.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Its proprietors re-opened the paper under its current name in 1905

events.text: The paper has been politically independent and non-aligned.
events.subject: self
events.quote: has been politically independent and non-aligned since the 1932

events.text: Mikael Pentikäinen was the editor-in-chief until he was fired from the post.

events.quote: Mikael Pentikäinen was the editor-in-chief until May 2012 when he was fired from the post

events.text: Riikka Venäläinen replaced him temporarily in the post.
